ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: I2C-derived byte-oriented bus protocol with a fixed set of SMBus transaction formats. Each transaction is START, slave-address+RW, [command code], [byte count], data byte(s), [PEC], STOP. PMBus carries its command codes in the SMBus Write/Read Byte/Word/Block transactions.

pec_crc.name: Packet Error Code (PEC)
pec_crc.coverage: all bytes of the transaction (address byte(s) including the R/W bit, command code, and all data bytes)
pec_crc.placement: one byte appended immediately before STOP

channels.name: SMBCLK
channels.description: Serial clock; may be clock-low-extended (stretched) by master or slave within timeout limits.

channels.name: SMBDAT
channels.description: Serial data; carries address, command, data, and PEC bytes MSB-first.

channels.name: SMBALERT#
channels.description: Optional shared interrupt; serviced via the Alert Response Address.

channels.name: CONTROL (PMBus)
channels.description: Hardware enable input on a power device; combines with OPERATION/ON_OFF_CONFIG.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Quick Command
smbus_protocol_formats.description: The single R/W bit conveys the whole message; no data byte, no PEC.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Write Byte / Write Word
smbus_protocol_formats.format: START, Address+Wr, Command, Data [, Data high], [PEC], STOP
smbus_protocol_formats.description: Write 1 byte (Byte) or 2 bytes low+high (Word) to a command code.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Read Byte / Read Word
smbus_protocol_formats.format: START, Address+Wr, Command, Sr, Address+Rd, Data [, Data high], [PEC], STOP
smbus_protocol_formats.description: Write the command then repeated-START read 1 (Byte) or 2 (Word) data bytes.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Process Call
smbus_protocol_formats.format: START, Address+Wr, Command, DataLo, DataHi, Sr, Address+Rd, DataLo, DataHi, [PEC], STOP

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Block Write
smbus_protocol_formats.format: START, Address+Wr, Command, ByteCount N, Data1..DataN, [PEC], STOP
smbus_protocol_formats.description: Byte Count (1..255) tells the slave how many data bytes follow.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Block Read
smbus_protocol_formats.format: START, Address+Wr, Command, Sr, Address+Rd, ByteCount N, Data1..DataN, [PEC], STOP
smbus_protocol_formats.description: Slave returns a Byte Count then that many data bytes.

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Block Write-Block Read Process Call
smbus_protocol_formats.format: Block Write immediately followed by Block Read

smbus_protocol_formats.name: Host Notify
smbus_protocol_formats.format: device-as-master writes to Host Notify address: own address + 16-bit data

addressing.rw_bit: 8th bit of the address byte (0 = write, 1 = read)

pmbus_command_framing.note: PMBus command codes are the SMBus command byte; the command determines whether the transaction is Write/Read Byte, Word, or Block.

frame_format.bit_order: MSB-first per byte; each byte ACK/NACK'd on the 9th clock.
frame_format.transaction_framing: START condition, then address+RW, then protocol-specific bytes (command / byte-count / data), optional PEC, STOP condition.
frame_format.repeated_start: Read Byte/Word, Process Call, and Block Read use a repeated START (Sr) to turn the bus around.
